reviews.title: Don’t tell me I’m ghosting
reviews.text: I downloaded the app for class and didn’t have to study yet and then I get a guilt trip? Not cool, does not make me want to use app.

reviews.title: no spacial repetition, no export feature in free version
reviews.text:
1) you cannot export your decks until you are a pro user. 
2) it doesn’t hide the cards whose repetition time hasn’t come yet, so if you have a small amount of cards, you will see them over and over again = no spacial repetition 
3) you also cannot see which cards you will be studying the next day, the day after et. so the process is not as transparent.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Pay walls everywhere, makes you rate how well you know each answer & slows down your deck considerably. Can barely use the free version, you have to pay or the app is useless.

reviews.title: Seriously?!!
reviews.text: $20 a month?!?!?!!!!  Such a rip off.  I may have paid $20 ONE TIME.

reviews.title: Not that smart.
reviews.text: When it shows you the answer, it asks you how well you understood it.  If you rate yourself a 5, it shows you the card less often.

reviews.title: Expensive flashcards
reviews.text: I need to pay a monthly subscription fee to look at flash cards that someone else created? What a joke.

reviews.title: Terrible UI
reviews.text:
User interface is just terrible on mobile, literally everything is 10x more difficult and time-taking than it needs to be.

For example, you can’t just drag to rearrange cards, the order is set which is so counterproductive. Why can’t I just move a card to be in the order I want it to?
Re ordering sets within a class as well, you have to choose the number position, instead of just dragging to order???I don’t understand why everything is so difficult too
It’s also so so slow, after deleting a card it takes about 6 seconds waiting time. Pretty much every loading is so long in comparison to other flashcard apps. Everything is just harder than it needs to be and it’s infuriating.

Also, for some reason now imputing csv format text into the import section gives you an AI summary even though I didn’t click that option?? Please fix this it is SO infuriating.

reviews.title: Absolutely not.
reviews.text: This seems like a great app until you find out that you have to rate every single flash card every single time and that this feature cannot be disabled. If I could disable this feature I would purchase a subscription but I cannot deal with the ridiculous rating system.

reviews.title: Lame
reviews.text: I thought this would test my knowledge, but all you’re doing is reading the cards! This DOES NOT TEST your knowledge

reviews.title: Doesn’t work on my phone anymore.
reviews.text: I really love to study with this app; however, in the past few months, when i attempt to click on the numbers to rate my knowledge on the card my screen freezes. I love the website version, but i wish the app worked as well. It was great until it stopped working.

reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.text: Started off with a deck of cards supposedly taken from a test for a certain certification. The material is indubitably in the workbook, but the test is multiple choice, and the cards have sometimes extensive and always open-ended questions. While this would be apposite for a higher level of certification, it doesn’t match my needs for Level 1.
